# viettelcloud_lb_server_group (Data Source)

Read details of a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer Server Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "viettelcloud_lb_server_group" "by_id" {
  load_balancer_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  id               = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002"
}

data "viettelcloud_lb_server_group" "by_name" {
  load_balancer_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  name             = "web-pool"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load Balancer ID (UUID) that owns this server group.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Server Group ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Name of the Server Group.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Load balancing algorithm.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Server Group was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the Server Group.
- `enable_h2` (Boolean) Whether HTTP/2 support is enabled.
- `health_check` (Attributes) Health check monitor configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `member_count` (Number) Number of backend members in the Server Group.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol for the server group.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status of the Server Group.
- `session_persistence` (Attributes) Session persistence configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--session_persistence))
- `status` (String) Operational status of the Server Group.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Server Group was last updated (RFC3339).

<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Read-Only:

- `delay` (Number) Delay between health checks in seconds.
- `expected_codes` (String) Expected HTTP status codes.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method to use.
- `max_retries` (Number) Number of successful checks before considering server online.
- `max_retries_down` (Number) Number of failed checks before considering server offline.
- `monitor_type` (String) Monitor type.
- `path` (String) HTTP URL path to check.
- `timeout` (Number) Health check timeout in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--session_persistence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `session_persistence`

Read-Only:

- `cookie_name` (String) Cookie name when session persistence type is APP_COOKIE.
- `type` (String) Session persistence type.
